capture_method: Native WPVibe authenticated GET reads; selected returned fields transcribed into this evidence record. This is not a byte-exact HTTP archive.
scope: Seven TSW chapters at named verse/range targets; four Fluent chapter-note sets; one additional Fluent schema control; two actual MVP passage-gateway responses; registry and route-source inspection.

vocabulary_samples.term: **ἀγάπη (agapē)**: Love expressed in committed regard and action.
**λογίζομαι (logizomai)**: Count, reckon, or keep an account.
**ἔσοπτρον (esoptron)**: Mirror, in antiquity typically polished metal.
**σκηνὴ τοῦ μαρτυρίου**: Tent of testimony, the sanctuary expression retained in the vision.

vocabulary_scope_caution: These four inspected entries demonstrate the live structural defect. They are not a fresh count of every defective entry on the websites.

schema_control.assessment: The chapter API has the verse/block/apparatus shape targeted by the comparison tool. Source-code deployment and complete frontend behavior have not been certified.

mvp_architecture.conclusion: The inspected MVP routes obtain their reader/passage data from Church Commons. Do not assume a separate MVP Bible dataset needs manual replacement.
mvp_architecture.limitation: Only the specified current routes and two passage responses were verified; future cache behavior and browser interactions remain to be tested.

release_boundary: Live discrepancies are expected before deployment and must not be relabeled as successful deployment. This batch publishes nothing.
